description: Controlled design research vocabulary derived from the prior repository's definitions, with explicit facets inspired by research navigation patterns.

entries.label: Account Setup
entries.description: First-time setup flow where a new user configures their account (name, username, profile details, initial preferences) right after signing up.

entries.label: Guided Tour & Tutorial
entries.description: Onboarding walkthrough, product tour, or step-by-step tutorial that explains features to a first-time user, often with coach marks, highlighted regions, or progress dots.

entries.label: Signup
entries.description: Account creation screen with fields like email, password, name, or social sign-up buttons (Continue with Google/Apple).

entries.label: Verification
entries.description: Screens for verifying identity via email code, SMS OTP, phone number confirmation, CAPTCHA, or two-factor authentication challenge.

entries.label: Delete & Deactivate Account
entries.description: Screens that let a user permanently delete or temporarily deactivate their account, usually with warnings and a final confirmation.

entries.label: Forgot Password
entries.description: Password recovery flow: enter email, receive a reset link/code, and set a new password.

entries.label: Login
entries.description: Sign-in screen with email/username and password fields, biometric prompt, or SSO buttons.

entries.label: My Account & Profile
entries.description: User-owned profile or account overview showing personal info, avatar, username, stats, and editable fields.

entries.label: Settings & Preferences
entries.description: App-wide settings hub: account, notifications, privacy, appearance, language, accessibility, and similar toggles organized in a list.

entries.label: Acknowledgement & Success
entries.description: Success or completion screen confirming an action was performed (e.g., 'Payment complete', 'Message sent'), often with a large checkmark or celebratory illustration.

entries.label: Action Option
entries.description: Screen or sheet offering the user a set of choices before continuing, such as action sheets, option pickers, or 'What do you want to do?' menus.

entries.label: Confirmation
entries.description: A 'Are you sure?' screen or modal asking the user to confirm a destructive or important action before it is executed.

entries.label: Empty State
entries.description: Screen shown when there is no content to display yet (empty inbox, no search results, no items), usually with an illustration and a call to action.

entries.label: Error
entries.description: Error screen or message indicating something went wrong (failed request, 404, crash, form validation summary) with an explanation and recovery option.

entries.label: Feature Info
entries.description: Informational screen describing a feature, often shown when it launches or is first opened, including 'What's new' and feature highlight screens.

entries.label: Feedback
entries.description: Screens asking the user for feedback: rating the app, leaving a comment, NPS survey, or a 'How was your experience?' prompt.

entries.label: Help & Support
entries.description: Help center, FAQ, contact support, chat-with-us, or troubleshooting screens.

entries.label: Loading
entries.description: A screen dominated by a loading indicator, spinner, progress bar, or skeleton placeholders while content is being fetched.

entries.label: Permission
entries.description: Screens or system prompts requesting permissions (notifications, camera, microphone, location, contacts, Bluetooth).

entries.label: Suggestions & Similar Items
entries.description: Screen that recommends content to the user: 'You may also like', 'Recommended for you', related items, or personalized suggestions.

entries.label: Billing
entries.description: Billing and invoicing screens showing charges, invoices, receipts, or billing history for a subscription or account.

entries.label: Cart & Bag
entries.description: Shopping cart or bag screen listing items the user has added, with quantities, price totals, and a checkout button.

entries.label: Checkout
entries.description: Multi-step checkout flow: shipping address, delivery option, payment, and review-and-pay screens.

entries.label: Order Confirmation
entries.description: Post-purchase confirmation screen showing 'Thanks for your order', order number, summary, and estimated delivery.

entries.label: Order Detail
entries.description: Detail view for a single order showing items purchased, status, tracking, shipping address, and totals.

entries.label: Order History
entries.description: List of the user's past orders or purchases, each with status and a link to details.

entries.label: Payment Method
entries.description: Screens for adding, editing, or selecting a payment method (credit card, PayPal, Apple Pay, bank account).

entries.label: Pricing
entries.description: Plan comparison or pricing tier screens showing feature-by-feature comparisons and prices.

entries.label: Promotions & Rewards
entries.description: Screens showcasing coupons, promo codes, loyalty rewards, referral bonuses, or seasonal discounts.

entries.label: Shop & Storefront
entries.description: Storefront landing or browse screen showing products, categories, featured collections, or a branded shop.

entries.label: Subscription & Paywall
entries.description: Upgrade, subscription, or paywall screens presenting plan options and a 'Subscribe' / 'Upgrade' call to action.

entries.label: Wallet & Balance
entries.description: Wallet overview showing account balance, points, credits, cards, or cryptocurrency holdings.

entries.label: Achievements & Awards
entries.description: Screens showing badges, trophies, streaks, or milestone awards earned by the user.

entries.label: Chat Detail
entries.description: Conversation view inside a messaging app showing a thread of messages with one contact or group.

entries.label: Comments
entries.description: Comment thread on a post, article, video, or product showing replies, likes, and reply composer.

entries.label: Followers & Following
entries.description: List of users someone follows or is followed by, with follow/unfollow buttons.

entries.label: Invite Teammates
entries.description: Screens to invite people by email, link, or contact list to a team, workspace, or group.

entries.label: Leaderboard
entries.description: Ranked list of users or teams by score, points, or activity, usually with position, avatar, and metric.

entries.label: Notifications
entries.description: Notifications inbox listing alerts, activity, mentions, and system messages with unread indicators.

entries.label: Reviews & Ratings
entries.description: Screens showing star ratings, reviews, or a form to leave a review for a product, place, or service.

entries.label: Social Feed
entries.description: Chronological or algorithmic feed of posts from followed users, including likes, comments, and share actions.

entries.label: User / Group Profile
entries.description: Profile page for another user or a group/community, showing avatar, bio, stats, and their content.

entries.label: Article Detail
entries.description: Long-form article or blog post reading view with title, byline, body text, and inline images.

entries.label: Browse & Discover
entries.description: Browse, explore, or discover screens with categories, curated sections, or search-driven discovery.

entries.label: Class & Lesson Detail
entries.description: Detail screen for an online course, class, or lesson with description, chapters, and 'Start' or 'Resume' actions.

entries.label: Code Editor
entries.description: Screens showing a code editor, IDE, or code playground with syntax-highlighted code and file tree.

entries.label: Emails & Messages
entries.description: Email inbox, message list, or email reading view (not 1-on-1 chat — think Gmail-style mail).

entries.label: Event Detail
entries.description: Detail view for an event: title, date/time, location, description, attendees, and RSVP button.

entries.label: Goal & Task
entries.description: Detail view for a goal, task, to-do, ticket, or project item with assignee, status, and description.

entries.label: Home
entries.description: Primary landing or home screen of an app — the dashboard the user sees first after launch or login.

entries.label: News Feed
entries.description: News or article feed with headlines, thumbnails, and summaries (distinct from a social feed of user posts).

entries.label: Note Detail
entries.description: A single note or document view in a notes/notebook app with rich text, attachments, or markdown.

entries.label: Other Content
entries.description: Catch-all for content detail screens that don't fit the other Content categories.

entries.label: Post Detail
entries.description: Detail view for a social post showing the full post, media, author, likes, and comments.

entries.label: Product Detail
entries.description: Product detail page: images, title, price, description, variants, reviews, and 'Add to cart' button.

entries.label: Quiz
entries.description: Quiz, test, or question-and-answer screens with multiple-choice options, progress, and scoring.

entries.label: Recipe Detail
entries.description: Detail view for a cooking recipe: ingredients, instructions, cook time, and hero photo.

entries.label: Song & Podcast Detail
entries.description: Now-playing or detail screen for a song, album, or podcast episode with artwork and playback controls.

entries.label: Stories
entries.description: Full-screen, tap-to-advance story viewer (Instagram/Snapchat-style) with progress bars at the top.

entries.label: TV Show & Movie Detail
entries.description: Detail page for a movie or show with poster, synopsis, cast, ratings, and a 'Play' button.

entries.label: Add & Create
entries.description: Screens for creating something new: new post, new project, new file, 'Create' flows and forms.

entries.label: Ban & Block
entries.description: Screens to block, mute, or ban a user, with warnings or reason selectors.

entries.label: Cancel
entries.description: Screens to cancel a subscription, order, booking, or in-progress action.

entries.label: Delete
entries.description: Screens focused on deleting an item, with a confirmation and usually a destructive red button.

entries.label: Draw & Annotate
entries.description: Drawing, sketching, markup, or annotation canvases with pen, brush, and shape tools.

entries.label: Edit
entries.description: Edit mode for an existing item (post, profile, document) with editable fields and Save/Cancel.

entries.label: Favorite & Pin
entries.description: Screens about favoriting, pinning, or starring items, or lists of the user's favorites.

entries.label: Filter & Sort
entries.description: Filter and sort panels or sheets with multi-select options, ranges, and an 'Apply' button.

entries.label: Flag & Report
entries.description: Screens to report content or a user, usually with reason options and a text box.

entries.label: Follow & Subscribe
entries.description: Screens to follow a user, channel, or topic, or subscribe to a feed, newsletter, or channel.

entries.label: Import & Export
entries.description: Screens to import data from other services or export data to a file or another service.

entries.label: Invite & Refer Friends
entries.description: Referral screens: share invite link, earn rewards for invites, and track pending invites.

entries.label: Like & Upvote
entries.description: Screens centered on liking, upvoting, or reacting to content with counts and reaction pickers.

entries.label: Move
entries.description: Screens to move an item to a different folder, list, board, or category.

entries.label: Other Action
entries.description: Catch-all for action-focused screens that don't fit the other Action categories.

entries.label: Publish
entries.description: Publish, post, or send flow: finalize content and push it live, often with visibility and scheduling options.

entries.label: Reorder
entries.description: Screens or modes for reordering items in a list via drag handles or up/down controls.

entries.label: Save
entries.description: Screens focused on saving something — save-to-collection, save as draft, or save-changes dialogs.

entries.label: Schedule
entries.description: Scheduling screens: pick a date/time to post, send, book, or run something in the future.

entries.label: Search
entries.description: Search entry screens, live search results, suggestions, and recent-search lists.

entries.label: Select
entries.description: Multi-select or item-picker modes where the user taps to select one or many items, often with a bulk-action bar.

entries.label: Set
entries.description: Screens for setting a value or configuration — alarms, reminders, goals, temperatures, thresholds.

entries.label: Share
entries.description: Share sheets, share-to-social screens, and link-sharing screens with copy/share options.

entries.label: Transfer & Send Money
entries.description: Money-movement screens: send, transfer, request, or receive funds, with amount, recipient, and confirmation.

entries.label: Upload & Download
entries.description: Screens for uploading files or media, and screens showing download progress or managing downloads.

entries.label: Charts
entries.description: Screens where charts or graphs (line, bar, pie, area) are the primary content, often with filters and legends.

entries.label: Dashboard
entries.description: Analytics dashboard: KPI tiles, charts, and data summaries on one screen, often customizable.

entries.label: Progress
entries.description: Progress tracking screens: habit streaks, fitness progress, goal completion, XP bars, and milestones.

entries.label: Bookmarks & Collections
entries.description: User-saved items organized into folders, collections, or boards (saved posts, bookmarked articles, wishlists).

entries.label: Playlists
entries.description: Playlist screens for music, video, or podcasts showing ordered tracks and playback controls.

entries.label: Trash & Archive
entries.description: Trash, recycle bin, or archive screens where deleted or archived items can be restored or purged.

entries.label: Audio Player
entries.description: Dedicated audio playback screen with artwork, scrubber, play/pause, next/previous, and volume.

entries.label: Audio & Video Recorder
entries.description: Recording screens for voice memos or video with a record button, waveform or viewfinder, and timer.

entries.label: Calendar
entries.description: Calendar views: month, week, day, or agenda with events on a grid or timeline.

entries.label: Call
entries.description: Voice or video call screens: incoming call, in-call UI with mute/hangup, and call history.

entries.label: Canvas
entries.description: Infinite or bounded canvas workspaces — whiteboards, diagramming, Figma/Miro-like editing surfaces.

entries.label: Chat Bot
entries.description: AI or rule-based chat bot screens with a prompt input and conversational reply bubbles.

entries.label: Command Palette
entries.description: Command palette or quick-action picker overlay (Cmd+K) with search and keyboard-driven actions.

entries.label: Date & Time
entries.description: Dedicated date-and-time picking screens or clock/time-zone utilities.

entries.label: Map
entries.description: Map-centric screens showing a map as primary content with pins, routes, search, or location picking.

entries.label: Media Editor
entries.description: Photo or video editor screens with filters, crop, adjustments, trimming, or layered edits.

entries.label: QR Code
entries.description: Screens that display or scan a QR code, often with a scanner viewfinder or a generated QR code image.

entries.label: Timeline & History
entries.description: Chronological history or activity log screens (audit log, version history, browsing history, timeline view).

entries.label: Timer & Clock
entries.description: Timer, stopwatch, or clock screens with large time display and start/stop controls.

entries.label: Video Player
entries.description: Video playback screens with video frame, scrubber, play/pause, volume, fullscreen, and captions.

entries.label: Kanban Board
entries.description: Column-based board layout (To Do / Doing / Done) with draggable cards, like Trello or Jira boards.

entries.label: Multi-Column Layout
entries.description: Layouts with two or more primary columns — dual-pane inbox, three-column Slack, master-detail-side layouts.

entries.label: Accordion
entries.description: Collapsible section with a header that expands or collapses a content area when tapped, often with a chevron.

entries.label: Breadcrumbs
entries.description: Horizontal trail of clickable path segments separated by '>' or '/' showing hierarchy and the current page.

entries.label: Button
entries.description: Tappable action control with text and/or icon — primary, secondary, tertiary, or destructive filled/outlined buttons.

entries.label: Checkbox
entries.description: A small square that can be checked or unchecked to toggle a boolean option, often used in lists.

entries.label: Color Picker
entries.description: Control for picking a color — swatches, color wheel, sliders, or hex input.

entries.label: Combobox
entries.description: Text field combined with a dropdown list of suggestions or selectable options (typeahead).

entries.label: Date Picker
entries.description: Control for selecting a date — calendar grid, wheel picker, or date input.

entries.label: Editable Text
entries.description: Inline-editable text that becomes a text field when clicked — commonly seen for renaming titles in place.

entries.label: File Upload
entries.description: Control for uploading files — drag-and-drop zone, file chooser button, or upload area with file previews.

entries.label: Floating Action Button
entries.description: Circular button that floats above content in a fixed screen position, usually a '+' for a primary action.

entries.label: Link
entries.description: Inline text link (typically underlined or colored) that navigates elsewhere when clicked.

entries.label: Page Control
entries.description: Row of small dots indicating current page/position in a carousel or paginated content (dot indicators).

entries.label: Pagination
entries.description: Numbered page navigation control with Previous/Next and page numbers (e.g., < 1 2 3 >).

entries.label: Radio Button
entries.description: Circular selector in a group where only one option can be selected at a time.

entries.label: Rating Control
entries.description: Star rating, thumbs-up/down, or emoji rating control used to capture a rating from the user.

entries.label: Search Bar
entries.description: Text input with a magnifying-glass icon for searching, often with a clear button and placeholder like 'Search'.

entries.label: Segmented Control
entries.description: Pill-shaped row of 2+ mutually exclusive options where one is highlighted as selected (like iOS segmented control).

entries.label: Select
entries.description: Dropdown select control showing a single value with a caret that opens a list of options.

entries.label: Slider
entries.description: Horizontal track with a draggable thumb used to pick a value within a range.

entries.label: Stepper
entries.description: +/- control for incrementing or decrementing a numeric value in small steps.

entries.label: Switch
entries.description: Toggle control (iOS-style switch) that flips a setting on or off, often with a colored background when on.

entries.label: Tab
entries.description: Horizontal row of tab labels where selecting one swaps the content area below it.

entries.label: Text Field
entries.description: Single- or multi-line text input box for user-entered text, with a label, placeholder, or helper text.

entries.label: Tile
entries.description: Tappable rectangular block (larger than a chip, simpler than a card) used to present options in a grid.

entries.label: Time Picker
entries.description: Control for selecting a time of day — clock face, wheel picker, or hour/minute inputs.

entries.label: Badge
entries.description: Small label or dot attached to an element showing a count or status (red notification dot, '99+' bubble).

entries.label: Banner
entries.description: Wide, full-width attention bar across a screen — announcements, alerts, or promotional banners.

entries.label: Card
entries.description: Contained rectangular unit (usually with a shadow or border) grouping related content like an image, title, and actions.

entries.label: Carousel
entries.description: Horizontally scrollable or swipeable row of cards/images, often paired with page dots.

entries.label: Chip
entries.description: Small, pill-shaped element representing a tag, filter, selected option, or person (with optional close icon).

entries.label: Divider
entries.description: Thin horizontal or vertical line used to separate groups of content.

entries.label: Gallery
entries.description: Grid or mosaic of images — photo gallery, media library thumbnails.

entries.label: Grid List
entries.description: A list presented in a grid of tiles or cards (as opposed to a vertical list).

entries.label: Keyboard Key
entries.description: Visual representation of a keyboard key or shortcut, like 'Cmd + K' badges in UI.

entries.label: Loading Indicator
entries.description: Spinner or circular progress indicator showing that content is loading (indeterminate).

entries.label: Map Pin
entries.description: Marker or pin icon placed on a map to indicate a location.

entries.label: Progress Indicator
entries.description: Determinate progress bar or circular progress showing percent complete, step count, or upload progress.

entries.label: Side Navigation
entries.description: Vertical navigation rail or sidebar down the left (or right) side of a screen with nav items and icons.

entries.label: Skeleton
entries.description: Gray placeholder shapes mimicking the layout of loading content (skeleton screens).

entries.label: Stacked List
entries.description: Vertical list of rows stacked top-to-bottom — list items, settings rows, inbox rows.

entries.label: Status Dot
entries.description: Small colored dot indicating online/offline, live, or status (green/yellow/red dot).

entries.label: Table
entries.description: Data table with rows and columns, column headers, and optionally sortable/filterable cells.

entries.label: Table of Contents
entries.description: Outline or jump-to-section list indicating the structure of a long document or page.

entries.label: Toolbar
entries.description: Compact bar of action icons/buttons, often at the top or bottom of a view (formatting toolbar, editor toolbar).

entries.label: Top Navigation Bar
entries.description: Horizontal bar at the top of a screen with title, back button, and action icons (app bar, nav bar, header).

entries.label: Tree
entries.description: Hierarchical tree view with expandable/collapsible parent-child nodes (file tree, org chart).

entries.label: Coach Marks
entries.description: Tooltip-style annotations layered over the UI to explain elements during onboarding, often numbered.

entries.label: Context Menu
entries.description: Right-click or long-press menu that appears next to an item with contextual actions.

entries.label: Dialog
entries.description: Modal dialog box centered over content with a title, body, and action buttons (OK/Cancel).

entries.label: Drawer
entries.description: Panel that slides in from an edge of the screen (left, right, top, or bottom) — side drawer or bottom sheet.

entries.label: Dropdown Menu
entries.description: Menu that opens below a button or trigger with a list of selectable actions or options.

entries.label: Full-Screen Overlay
entries.description: A full-screen modal overlay that takes over the entire viewport, often used for lightboxes or takeovers.

entries.label: Navigation Menu
entries.description: Expanded navigation overlay (often the hamburger menu) that takes over part or all of the screen.

entries.label: Popover
entries.description: Small overlay anchored to a trigger element, floating over content with arrow/tail pointing to its source.

entries.label: Toast
entries.description: Short, auto-dismissing notification appearing briefly at the top or bottom of the screen (snackbar).

entries.label: Tooltip
entries.description: Small hover/long-press hint showing a brief text label about an element.

entries.label: Avatar
entries.description: Circular (or squircle) profile image representing a person, account, or group — may show initials if no photo.

entries.label: Icon
entries.description: Small, single-concept pictogram used in buttons, lists, and navigation (usually monochromatic line or filled icon).

entries.label: Illustration
entries.description: Decorative, flat or stylized illustration — often used in empty states, onboarding, and marketing surfaces.

entries.label: Logo
entries.description: Brand logo or wordmark for an app, product, or company.

entries.label: Photo
entries.description: Photographic image — real-world photography as opposed to illustration or icon.

entries.label: Animation & Video
entries.description: Animated content or video playing inline — Lottie animations, looping videos, GIFs embedded in the UI.

entries.label: Hero Image
entries.description: Large, prominent image/graphic at the top of a screen used as a banner or header (hero/banner image).

entries.label: Thumbnail
entries.description: Small preview image representing a larger asset (video thumb, file preview, album art thumbnail).

excludedLegacyLabels.reason: Too broad to be a reliable visual screen label
